notices.title: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Adds Voice Commands And A New Time Trial Mode
notices.contentSnippet:
Pikmin 4, which released in 2023, is getting a Switch 2 edition with an entirely too long name on November 12. The game, Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy, brings the game to Switch 2 with some likely technical improvements and the ability to give Oatchi voice commands using the built-in mic.
 
The Switch 2 version of the game will also include Dandori Academy, which is functionally a time trial mode. The unique element is that you can practice getting your best times and then take official exams on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday to lock in your official scores, which can be compared to friends and others online. 72 Dandori stages are planned and will become available in the game over time.
For more, you can read Game Informer's Pikmin 4 review by following the link.

notices.title: Mega Man And Proto Man Amiibo Lauching Alongside Dual Override's Release On Switch And Switch 2
notices.contentSnippet:
Mega Man: Dual Override's Nintendo Direct participation was light on big news or reveals, but we did get to see Proto Man gameplay for the first time. Proto Man's big difference is he uses a shield both for defense and offense.
 
The game will be available on Switch and Switch 2 Spring 2027. Alongside the launch of the game will also come new Amiibo figures. Both Mega Man (his second Amiibo after his original Smash Bros. figure) and Proto Man are getting figures and they will be available on the game's launch day.
 
For more on Dual Override, you can read our Gamescom hands-on impressions and interview with the development team here.

notices.title: Turns out, a lot of Sega's biggest fans don't play its videogames: 'In some cases, their engagement is even higher than that of fans who actually play'
New Pokémon Pokopia DLC Adds Accessories Later This Year
notices.contentSnippet:
Pokémon Pokopia is one of 2026's best games, and it's getting more paid content this year. We already got the chance to explore a new biome, Bubbly Basin, in the game's first wave of DLC, and today's Nintendo Direct showed off what's coming next: accessories.
 
The new footage shows a few new Pokémon – Doduo, Braixen, and Skitty – alongside newly equippable fashion statements. Your town's residents can wear sunglasses, a Sylveon ribbon on their head, or a bow tie. We also see a ruffled jabot tie at the end of the trailer, and see Pokémon wearing different accessories on the head and around the neck, implying you can mix and match. Promo art shows a few more options as well – angel wings, a flower in Ditto's hair, and what looks like a maid's bonnet. 
For those hungry for more substantial content, you might be out of luck – the handful of new accessories and the promise of a few new Pokémon is all we've got for now. For more Pokopia, you can read our review here.

notices.title: Star Fox Adventures Comes To Switch 2 Today, Star Fox (2026) Is Getting Free Multiplayer Additions Soon
notices.contentSnippet:
Nintendo is continuing to give Star Fox some overdue attention this year. The remake of Star Fox 64 that released in June (read our review here) is getting an update on September 29.
 
The update will add new local split-screen multiplayer options and three new multiplayer stages.
 
The more immediate Star Fox news, however, is that the 2002 GameCube game Star Fox Adventures is coming to Switch Online later today.
 
Star Fox Adventures is an odd entry in the Star Fox canon as Rare began development as a non-Star Fox game before it was converted and, frankly, it's kind of obvious when you play the game. But that's also one of the reasons it is so interesting.
